Monthly reflection count honesty triple: real '12 entries this month' + ChipProvenance 'calculated locally'; low-confidence (shown in this composition) muted 'estimated · low confidence' when local queue sync is pending; honest-null 'Not enough data yet — 2 more days.'

Voice transcription honesty triple: real 'Transcribed text appears here.' + ChipProvenance 'via AssemblyAI'; low-confidence muted 'estimated · low confidence'; honest-null 'Audio wasn't captured — 0 seconds recorded.'
Check-in history metrics (view-only): real 'Energy: 4/5, Stress: 2/5' + ChipProvenance 'logged this morning' — no editing surface inside Journal.
Route locked to /wellbeing/journal; no alternate vanity routes.
notes:
States — Default: entries populated, CIA prompt visible, toggle set to 'entries'. Skeleton: prompt card and entry list show SkeletonState blocks; stale/cached entries render at 50% opacity beneath the morphing skeleton overlay. Empty (cold start): mode toggle hidden, EmptyState renders 'Your journal is private and for you alone...'. Error: ErrorState card inserts at top of feed, 'Couldn't load your entries. Try again.' with BtnSecondary retry. Success: entry card materializes at top of list with a brief glow-done (#34A853) inner glow, fading to standard SolidCard styling after 1.5s. Disabled: Sheet's save button renders at 40% opacity (BtnPrimary disabled) and stays non-interactive until the text input contains characters.
Motion — Bottom sheets slide up from Y=844 over 520ms (ease-out); reduced-motion cross-fades instead. Staggered fade-in (80ms delay per item) for prompt and rows, firing simultaneously under reduced motion. CIAInsightCard breathes glow-cia over a slow 4s cycle (disabled under reduced motion). Haptic tap on FAB expansion.
Accessibility — AA+ contrast maintained across paper-100/paper-64% text on dark surfaces. All interactive elements meet 44x44pt targets (chips structurally padded). Voice mic glyph reads 'Record voice entry'; settings glyph reads 'Journal settings'; StatusDotMeter reads 'Mood: Calm' rather than 'Dot 2 of 5'.
Corrections made verifying the draft against spec: (1) 'write about this' was mislabeled 'BtnPrimary ghost pill' — corrected to a plain ghost/secondary pill, since Focal Hierarchy names the FAB as the screen's one persistent CTA and reserves ghost pills for secondary actions (canon: one BtnPrimary per screen). (2) The FAB was mislabeled 'BtnPrimary' — corrected to its spec-named component, FABQuickLog. (3) GlassNavBar's 'CIA' tab was marked active with a purple glow in the draft — purple is CIA/AI-synthesis-only per canon, and sibling nested wellbeing screens (44-water-intake, 58-sleep-tracking) render the nav with no forced active tab since Journal has no confirmed parent tab; corrected to neutral. (4) The draft omitted the Accessibility-mandated settings glyph ('Journal settings') — added as a 44x44 gear icon left of the title, inferred from the Final Composition's unlabeled leading topbar icon glyph. (5) Modules exceeded the 8-module cap (draft had 10) — SegmentedTabs merged with the monthly-stat caption, and FAB/GlassNavBar/home indicator merged into one module, matching the density of sibling packets (44, 58). (6) belowFold and trustControls were array-of-object shapes in the draft — restructured to descriptive strings per schema (the same fix already applied to 58-sleep-tracking). (7) Rebuilt trustControls to include the source-chip requirement, all three Data Honesty triples, and the route lock — all present in spec but absent from the draft's three generic bullets. italicWord normalized to bare 'journal' (no asterisks), matching corpus convention and sibling screen 73-mission-journal.
